column1: # Machine-readable half of the terminology policy.
# Each row: a source term that stays English, and the Persian calque that
# must never appear in its place. `scripts/check-fa.py` reads this file and
# fails the build when the forbidden form shows up in a translation.
#   english          source form that must survive in the output
#   forbidden_fa     Persian form that is wrong for this source term
#   scope            `universal`, or a domain pack from glossary-domains.md
# `universal` rows are enforced on every document. Domain rows are enforced
# only with `--domains <name>` (or `--domains all`). Add a row here at the
# same time you add a Keep-English note in glossary.md; this file is the
# single source of truth for the checker.
